lsrc_casing_diameter.quote: is a four-stage compressor having a constant casing diameter of 1.524 m (60 in.) and a radius ratio of 0.85.

lsrc_radius_ratio.quote: is a four-stage compressor having a constant casing diameter of 1.524 m (60 in.) and a radius ratio of 0.85.

number_of_stages.quote: The LSRC configuration for these tests, shown schematically in Figure 1, is a four-stage compressor having a constant casing diameter of 1.524 m (60 in.)
number_of_stages.notes: Four identical stages plus IGV; the third stage is the test stage (CR-135391 pdf p12: 'four identical stages will be employed. The third stage will be the test stage.').

airfoil_span.quote: The airfoils are 11.43 cm (4.5 in.) in span and approximately 9 cm (3.5 in.) in chord

rotor_blade_count.notes: Label in Figure 3 'Cross Section of 0.85 Radius Ratio Compressor Stage' (printed page 27). No separate count is printed for Rotor B/C.

igv_vane_count.quote: The pitchline solidity of the 53 IGV's was chosen to be approximately 1.0 and the pitchline chord was computed.

rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ba.quote: The average rotor tip-clearance-to-blade-height ratio was 1.36% and the average stator seal-clearance-to-blade-height ratio was 0.78%.
rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ba.notes: Rotor A/Stator A tests. Design value in CR-135391 Table 2 is 1.35 % (Stage A).

stator_seal_clearance_over_blade_height_.quote: The average rotor tip-clearance-to-blade-height ratio was 1.36% and the average stator seal-clearance-to-blade-height ratio was 0.78%.
stator_seal_clearance_over_blade_height_.notes: Shrouded stators ('Shrouded stators are used.', pdf p17).

casing_treatment.quote: Circumferential groove casing treatment was applied over the tip of only the first rotor to assure that Stage 1 would not be the stall-limiting blading.

rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ro.quote: The tests were conducted at an average rotor tip-clearance-to-blade-height ratio of 1.53% and an average stator seal-clearance-to-blade-height ratio of 0.78%.
rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ro.notes: Quote checked against the page image (pdf p19, printed 13).

rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ro.quote: Rotor C is running with a slightly larger rotor tip-clearance-to-blade-height, e/h, of 1.53% compared to 1.43% for Rotor B.
rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ro.notes: Quote checked against the page image (pdf p19, printed 13).

rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ro.quote: Overall performance of the Rotor B/Stator B Four-Stage Configuration was obtained at an increased tip-clearance-to-blade-height ratio of 2.80%
rotor_tip_clearance_over_blade_height_ro.notes: Quote checked against the page image (pdf p25, printed 6). CR-165357 pdf p22 repeats the nominal 1.36 % / 0.78 %; CR-165358 p19 gives 1.43 % for the Rotor B tests (inconsistent with 1.36 %, both kept).

stator_B_stacking.quote: the airfoil sections were stacked at 30 percent chord rather than at the usual 50 percent chord location.
stator_B_stacking.notes: CR-165553 pdf p16: 'the vane was stacked at 30 percent chord from the leading edge in order to reduce the leading edge lean angle.'

design_flow_coefficient.quote: which is somewhat larger than the design flow coefficient of 0.407.
design_flow_coefficient.notes: Based on rotor tip speed (CR-135391 Table 2 footnote: 0.442 on pitch speed, 0.407 on tip speed). CR-159498 summary (pdf p15, image checked) says 'design intent flow coefficient of 0.408'.

design_pressure_coefficient_tip_speed.quote: Based on rotor tip speed, this value becomes 0.555.
design_pressure_coefficient_tip_speed.notes: Footnote to Table 2. CR-159498 summary (pdf p15, image checked): 'the design intent pressure coefficient of 0.554 has been achieved at the design intent flow coefficient of 0.408.'

tip_speed_lsrc.quote: the large size (1.5 m diameter) and low tip speed (60 m/sec) of this test rig
tip_speed_lsrc.notes: Approximate. Tables 3/4 give U = 57.61 m/sec at r = 76.20 cm.

reynolds_number.quote: the blade chord Reynolds number is about 360,000.

rotor_profile.quote: The rotor airfoil sections consisted of modified circular arc meanlines with double-circular-arc-type thickness distributions.

stator_profile.quote: The stator airfoil sections consisted of modified circular-arc meanlines with 65-series thickness distributions.

stage7_rotor_profile.quote: Rotor 7 airfoil sections were designed to be double-circular-arc-type airfoils

stage7_stator_profile.quote: Stator 7 airfoil sections were designed by using a 65-series thickness distribution on a circular arc meanline

rotorA_DCAM_LE.quote: The amount of overcambering required for Rotor A was 6.5 degrees at all radii.
rotorA_DCAM_LE.notes: Table 5 shows 6.50 to SL7 and 6.60-8.50 from SL8 to the hub.

rotorA_DCAM_TE_hub.quote: a similar decambering (ΔCAMTE = -8 degrees) was employed in the Rotor A hub region.

statorA_DCAM_LE.quote: Stator A required 3.5 degrees of leading edge overcambering (ΔCAMLE) relative to a circular-arc-type meanline

rotorB_tip_mods.value: DCAM_LE 2.0 deg, DCAM_TE 6.0 deg, tmax at 60% chord at tip
rotorB_tip_mods.quote: for Rotor B, 2.0 degrees of ΔCAM were specified in the leading edge tip region (Rotor A had 6.5 degrees) and 6.0 degrees of ΔCAM were specified in the trailing edge tip region (Rotor A had 0.0 degrees). In addition, the maximum thickness was moved from 50 percent chord to 60 percent chord

meanline_modification_equation_1.notes: Definition of the empirical X-factor; its radial distribution for Stage A is Figure 13 (figure only).

igv_design_method.value: Dunavant curves; constant chord; pitchline solidity about 1.0
igv_design_method.quote: The IGV was designed following the guidelines of Dunavant (Reference 5). The pitchline solidity of the 53 IGV's was chosen to be approximately 1.0 and the pitchline chord was computed. This chord was held constant and values of solidity across the span were computed. Then values of lift coefficient, CLo, and angle-of-attack (stagger) were determined from the curves of Dunavant. These values of lift coefficient and angle-of-attack are shown in Figure 22.
igv_design_method.notes: IGV chord value is not printed; C_Lo and angle of attack only in Fig. 22 (figure only).
